messages:
jess: Heads-up — planning a config-only deploy tonight 21:00 UTC (change window 21:00-23:00). No binaries. Changes: per-request timeout 6000ms -> 5000ms, batch window 30ms -> 25ms, tenant soft caps tightened, routing weight floor adjusted. Will pin model variant v3.2 for canary. Looking for SRE + Platform ack and any tenant exclusions.
micah: Ack. I'll shadow dashboards (p95 latency, error-rate, kvcache misses). What's the canary plan?
jess: Canary: 1% traffic for 20m, then 10% for 40m, then full if green. Deploy via deploy-bot. Rollback plan: immediate revert of config + re-pin prior config; manual rollback trigger OR auto on alerts.
ravi: Exclude enterprise and dedicated customers from canary (we should not touch reserved tenants). Also want run-id tagging for observability.
jess: Good call, excluding enterprise/dedicated. Will add run=1788887776 tag.
deploy-bot: Queued config-only deploy 1788887776 by jess. Changes: {"timeout_ms":5000,"batch_window_ms":25,"soft_caps":"tighten"}, canary_exclude=[enterprise,dedicated], pin_variant=v3.2. Prechecks: lint, schema, conflicts.
ops-bot: Preflight checks complete — lint OK, schema OK, no conflicting open deploys.
micah: Add alert rule: if p95 latency increases >200ms from baseline OR error rate >0.5% absolute -> trigger auto-rollback. Also notify #eng-oncall.
jess: Done — added alert and notification. Also adding a 10-minute hold between canary phases for manual review.
deploy-bot: Canary start scheduled at 21:00 UTC. Phase 1 -> 1% traffic.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 21:00 UTC (phase 1).
micah: Seeing +30ms on p95 in canary nodes, error-rate flat. kvcache misses slightly up (+6%). Nothing alarming.
ravi: Observability tag applied: run=1788887776 on traces/logs.
jess: After 20m hold — ready to move to 10%?
micah: Go for 10%. Metrics within thresholds.
deploy-bot: Ramping to 10% at 21:25 UTC.
micah: At 10% now — p95 +45ms, errors normal. kvcache pressure creeping (+12% misses) but not violating thresholds.
ravi: We should monitor kvcache for another 20m; if it climbs we may want a small TTL bump later.
jess: I'd prefer to keep minimal changes during window. Monitor 20m, decide then.
deploy-bot: 10% steady for 40m -> no auto-rollback triggered. Scheduling full rollout at 22:05 UTC with 10m cushion.
micah: Noting a small KV pressure in canary pods — file INF-4924 to track kvcache tuning post-rollout.
jess: Agree — INF-4924 created, will handle post-change. Proceed with full rollout at 22:10 if no alerts.
deploy-bot: Full rollout started at 22:10 UTC.
ops-bot: Post-deploy checks: service health OK, error-rate within baseline, latency within acceptable delta. No 5xx spikes.
ravi: LGTM :thumbsup:
jess: Closing change window. Release notes: config-only deploy (limits/timeouts/routing/batching). Canary excluded enterprise/dedicated. Run id: 1788887776. Tracking tickets: INF-4923 (release), INF-4924 (kvcache followup).
micah: I'll follow up on KV TTL analysis tomorrow. Thanks team!
deploy-bot: Deploy complete — all steps finished successfully for 1788887776.
